# Chitraboli চিত্রাবলী

> Chitraboli is a handmade jewellery brand from Bangladesh creating rings, necklaces, earrings and bangles inspired by art, tradition and passion.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, featured collections, and new arrivals.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all handmade jewellery with search and filters.
- [Collections](/collections): Curated jewellery collections by theme.
- [About](/about): The story of Chitraboli and its artisans.
- [Contact](/contact): Customer support and inquiries.
- [Track Order](/track-order): Look up an existing order by ID and phone.
